get.summary: List codespaces for the organization
get.desc:
Lists the codespaces associated to a specified organization.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

put.summary: Manage access control for organization codespaces
put.desc:
Sets which users can access codespaces in an organization. This is synonymous with granting or revoking codespaces access permissions for users according to the visibility.
OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

visibility.description: Which users can access codespaces in the organization. `disabled` means that no users can access codespaces in the organization.

selected_usernames.description: The usernames of the organization members who should have access to codespaces in the organization. Required when `visibility` is `selected_members`. The provided list of usernames will replace any existing value.

post.summary: Add users to Codespaces access for an organization

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

selected_usernames.description: The usernames of the organization members whose codespaces be billed to the organization.

delete.summary: Remove users from Codespaces access for an organization

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

selected_usernames.description: The usernames of the organization members whose codespaces should not be billed to the organization.

get.summary: List organization secrets
get.desc:
Lists all Codespaces development environment secrets available at the organization-level without revealing their encrypted
values.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

get.summary: Get an organization public key
get.desc:
Gets a public key for an organization, which is required in order to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt the value of a secret before you can create or update secrets.
OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

get.summary: Get an organization secret
get.desc:
Gets an organization development environment secret without revealing its encrypted value.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

put.summary: Create or update an organization secret

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

encrypted_value.description: The value for your secret, encrypted with [LibSodium](https://libsodium.gitbook.io/doc/bindings_for_other_languages) using the public key retrieved from the [Get an organization public key](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/organization-secrets#get-an-organization-public-key) endpoint.

key_id.description: The ID of the key you used to encrypt the secret.

visibility.description: Which type of organization repositories have access to the organization secret. `selected` means only the repositories specified by `selected_repository_ids` can access the secret.

selected_repository_ids.description: An array of repository IDs that can access the organization secret. You can only provide a list of repository IDs when the `visibility` is set to `selected`. You can manage the list of selected repositories using the [List selected repositories for an organization secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/organization-secrets#list-selected-repositories-for-an-organization-secret), [Set selected repositories for an organization secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/organization-secrets#set-selected-repositories-for-an-organization-secret), and [Remove selected repository from an organization secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/organization-secrets#remove-selected-repository-from-an-organization-secret) endpoints.

delete.desc:
Deletes an organization development environment secret using the secret name.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

get.summary: List selected repositories for an organization secret
get.desc:
Lists all repositories that have been selected when the `visibility`
for repository access to a secret is set to `selected`.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

put.summary: Set selected repositories for an organization secret

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

selected_repository_ids.description: An array of repository ids that can access the organization secret. You can only provide a list of repository ids when the `visibility` is set to `selected`. You can add and remove individual repositories using the [Set selected repositories for an organization secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/organization-secrets#set-selected-repositories-for-an-organization-secret) and [Remove selected repository from an organization secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/organization-secrets#remove-selected-repository-from-an-organization-secret) endpoints.

put.summary: Add selected repository to an organization secret

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

delete.summary: Remove selected repository from an organization secret

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

get.summary: List codespaces in a repository for the authenticated user
get.desc:
Lists the codespaces associated to a specified repository and the authenticated user.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

post.summary: Create a codespace in a repository
post.desc:
Creates a codespace owned by the authenticated user in the specified repository.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

ref.description: Git ref (typically a branch name) for this codespace

location.description: The requested location for a new codespace. Best efforts are made to respect this upon creation. Assigned by IP if not provided.

geo.description: The geographic area for this codespace. If not specified, the value is assigned by IP. This property replaces `location`, which is closing down.

client_ip.description: IP for location auto-detection when proxying a request

machine.description: Machine type to use for this codespace

devcontainer_path.description: Path to devcontainer.json config to use for this codespace

multi_repo_permissions_opt_out.description: Whether to authorize requested permissions from devcontainer.json

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Time in minutes before codespace stops from inactivity

retention_period_minutes.description: Duration in minutes after codespace has gone idle in which it will be deleted. Must be integer minutes between 0 and 43200 (30 days).

get.summary: List devcontainer configurations in a repository for the authenticated user
get.desc:
Lists the devcontainer.json files associated with a specified repository and the authenticated user. These files
specify launchpoint configurations for codespaces created within the repository.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

get.summary: List available machine types for a repository
get.desc:
List the machine types available for a given repository based on its configuration.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: location
params.desc: The location to check for available machines. Assigned by IP if not provided.

params.name: client_ip
params.desc: IP for location auto-detection when proxying a request

params.name: ref
params.desc: The branch or commit to check for prebuild availability and devcontainer restrictions.

get.summary: Get default attributes for a codespace
get.desc:
Gets the default attributes for codespaces created by the user with the repository.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: ref
params.desc: The branch or commit to check for a default devcontainer path. If not specified, the default branch will be checked.

params.name: client_ip
params.desc: An alternative IP for default location auto-detection, such as when proxying a request.

get.summary: Check if permissions defined by a devcontainer have been accepted by the authenticated user
get.desc:
Checks whether the permissions defined by a given devcontainer configuration have been accepted by the authenticated user.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: devcontainer_path
params.desc: Path to the devcontainer.json configuration to use for the permission check.

get.summary: List secrets for the authenticated user
get.desc:
Lists all development environment secrets available for a user's codespaces without revealing their
encrypted values.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

get.summary: Get public key for the authenticated user
get.desc:
Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

get.summary: Get a secret for the authenticated user
get.desc:
Gets a development environment secret available to a user's codespaces without revealing its encrypted value.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

put.summary: Create or update a secret for the authenticated user

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

encrypted_value.description: Value for your secret, encrypted with [LibSodium](https://libsodium.gitbook.io/doc/bindings_for_other_languages) using the public key retrieved from the [Get the public key for the authenticated user](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#get-public-key-for-the-authenticated-user) endpoint.

key_id.description: ID of the key you used to encrypt the secret.

selected_repository_ids.description: An array of repository ids that can access the user secret. You can manage the list of selected repositories using the [List selected repositories for a user secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#list-selected-repositories-for-a-user-secret), [Set selected repositories for a user secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#set-selected-repositories-for-a-user-secret), and [Remove a selected repository from a user secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#remove-a-selected-repository-from-a-user-secret) endpoints.

delete.summary: Delete a secret for the authenticated user
delete.desc:
Deletes a development environment secret from a user's codespaces using the secret name. Deleting the secret will remove access from all codespaces that were allowed to access the secret.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

get.summary: List selected repositories for a user secret
get.desc:
List the repositories that have been granted the ability to use a user's development environment secret.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

put.summary: Set selected repositories for a user secret
put.desc:
Select the repositories that will use a user's development environment secret.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

selected_repository_ids.description: An array of repository ids for which a codespace can access the secret. You can manage the list of selected repositories using the [List selected repositories for a user secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#list-selected-repositories-for-a-user-secret), [Add a selected repository to a user secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#add-a-selected-repository-to-a-user-secret), and [Remove a selected repository from a user secret](https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/secrets#remove-a-selected-repository-from-a-user-secret) endpoints.

put.summary: Add a selected repository to a user secret
put.desc:
Adds a repository to the selected repositories for a user's development environment secret.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

delete.summary: Remove a selected repository from a user secret
delete.desc:
Removes a repository from the selected repositories for a user's development environment secret.

The authenticated user must have Codespaces access to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` or `codespace:secrets` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: secret_name
params.desc: The name of the secret.

get.summary: Get a codespace for the authenticated user
get.desc:
Gets information about a user's codespace.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

patch.summary: Update a codespace for the authenticated user
patch.desc:
Updates a codespace owned by the authenticated user. Currently only the codespace's machine type and recent folders can be modified using this endpoint.

If you specify a new machine type it will be applied the next time your codespace is started.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

machine.description: A valid machine to transition this codespace to.

recent_folders.description: Recently opened folders inside the codespace. It is currently used by the clients to determine the folder path to load the codespace in.

delete.summary: Delete a codespace for the authenticated user
delete.desc:
Deletes a user's codespace.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

post.summary: Export a codespace for the authenticated user
post.desc:
Triggers an export of the specified codespace and returns a URL and ID where the status of the export can be monitored.

If changes cannot be pushed to the codespace's repository, they will be pushed to a new or previously-existing fork instead.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

get.summary: Get details about a codespace export
get.desc:
Gets information about an export of a codespace.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

params.name: export_id
params.desc: The ID of the export operation, or `latest`. Currently only `latest` is currently supported.

get.summary: List machine types for a codespace
get.desc:
List the machine types a codespace can transition to use.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

post.summary: Create a repository from an unpublished codespace

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

name.description: A name for the new repository.

private.description: Whether the new repository should be private.

post.summary: Start a codespace for the authenticated user
post.desc:
Starts a user's codespace.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.

post.summary: Stop a codespace for the authenticated user
post.desc:
Stops a user's codespace.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: codespace_name
params.desc: The name of the codespace.
